# Estilo\nResponda curto e direto: sem p:
# Style
Answer short and direct: no preamble, without repeating the request and without summarizing what you just did. This does not apply to book text the author asks for (write it in full, in their style).
A IA não lê nem altera arquivos: só conv: The AI does not read or change files: it only chats. Saves a lot, since the tool definitions are not sent. The chat's quick-reply buttons keep working. When on, the other options are locked.
Quanto das tools vai em cada pedido (ela: How much of the tools goes in each request (they count toward the tokens-per-minute limit). Summary: just 1 line per tool, and the AI asks for the specification of the ones it needs. The ones requested stay unlocked for the rest of the session.
Mínimo: só leitura de arquivos e botões: Minimal: only file reading and buttons (no writing)
Econômico: edição pontual + sumário das: Economy: targeted editing + summary of the rest
Envia as instruções do app, a descrição: Sends the app's instructions, the tool descriptions and the skill text in a leaner form (prompt compaction, “caveman” style: no frills and short sentences) and asks the AI for short answers. Uses fewer tokens; never touches your book's text.
Depois de sincronizar, a IA cria o resum: After syncing, the AI creates the summary (digest) of new or changed files. Off: no analysis is offered (you can run it manually).
Analisar em segundo plano, sem pedir aut: Analyze in the background, without asking permission
Desligado: o app mostra a estimativa de: Off: the app shows the token estimate and asks before spending.
Extrair fatos dos arquivos (base das con: Extract facts from files (basis for contradictions)
Traços, idades, parentescos e regras do: Traits, ages, family ties and world rules. Without this the app cannot find contradictions between files.
O sistema acha os candidatos sem gastar: The system finds the candidates without spending tokens; the AI only confirms the doubtful ones, with short quotes.
Extrai eventos e datas dos textos para a: Extracts events and dates from the texts for the timeline and to find ordering inconsistencies.
Analisar inconsistências de tom e forma: Analyze inconsistencies in tone and writing style
Registra o narrador (pessoa), o tempo ve: Records the narrator (person), the tense and the tone of each file and warns when a chapter strays from the book's pattern.
Comparar os capítulos com o objetivo do: Compare the chapters with the book's goal
Uma conferência extra da IA: os resumos: An extra check by the AI: the chapter summaries against the synopsis (the soul of the book).
Se a estimativa passar disso, a análise: If the estimate goes over this, the analysis stops and continues next time.
Mensagens de histórico enviadas ao chat: History messages sent to the chat
Quanto da conversa anterior vai junto a: How much of the previous conversation goes with each message. Fewer messages = fewer tokens, but the AI remembers less of the conversation.
Só leitura: a IA lê arquivos quando você: Read-only: the AI reads files when you ask (respecting permissions) and uses the chat buttons, but changes and creates nothing. Nothing is analyzed on its own and the history sent is short. For the AI to write, use Economy or above.
Envia as tools de edição pontual (substi: Sends the targeted-editing tools (replace and append passage) and only a summary of the rest (the AI asks for the ones it needs). Summarizes files asking first and finds contradictions through the system only, without AI verification.
O padrão: as tools mais usadas completas: The default: the most used tools in full and the summary of the others; summaries, verified contradictions and timeline, always asking before spending.
Também confere tom e forma de escrita, e: Also checks tone and writing style, and analyzes in the background without asking.
Tudo ligado, inclusive a comparação dos: Everything on, including comparing the chapters with the book's goal. Uses more tokens.

# Ferramentas (modo simulado)\nVocê pode:
# Tools (simulated mode)
You can use tools. To use one, reply ONLY with a block in this exact format (one block per tool, no text after it):

<tool_call>
{"name": "tool_name", "arguments": {"parameter": "value"}}
</tool_call>

The system runs the tool and replies with a message starting with "[Result of tool_name]". Only then continue. When you need no more tools, reply normally, in text, with no <tool_call> block.

Available tools (name(parameters) — description; "?" marks an optional parameter):
A IA excedeu o limite de chamadas de fer: The AI exceeded the tool call limit.
Devolve a especificação completa (descri: Returns the full specification (description and parameters) of tools in the summary and unlocks them for use. Call it before using a tool that only appears in the summary.
Names of the tools in the summary.
# Modo de uso mínimo\nNeste modo você SÓ:
# Minimal usage mode
In this mode you can ONLY READ files (`read_file`, using the paths from the Book map) and show buttons (`show_buttons`). You have NO tools to change or create anything, nor to request other tools. If the author asks for a change or creation, do not pretend or say you did it: explain that in this profile you can only read and offer a button (`show_buttons` with action `open-central`, central `ai`, tab `analysis`) for them to change the AI usage profile.
# Outras tools (sumário)\nAlém das tools:
# Other tools (summary)
Besides the declared tools, the ones below exist. To use one of them, first call `{specsTool}` with the names (you get the specification and the tool is unlocked). To CHANGE an existing file, request `replace_in_file`, `append_to_file` or `write_file`; do not use the creation tools for that.
A tool \"{name}\" ainda não está liberad: The tool "{name}" is not unlocked yet: call {specsTool} with its name.
A tool \"{name}\" não está disponível ne: The tool "{name}" is not available in this AI usage mode.
Informe 'names' com os nomes das tools d: Provide 'names' with the names of the tools in the summary.
